script:
set -e
RES=/workspace/results/gsplat_kazbek-run-m-fidelity
CKPT=$(ls $RES/ckpts/ckpt_*_rank0.pt | sort -V | tail -1)
python3 /workspace/pod-runtime/pod/export_ply.py "$CKPT" /tmp/kazbek-run-m-fidelity.ply
python3 /workspace/pod-runtime/pod/hf_upload.py --repo miguelemosreverte/alambique-datasets --prefix checkpoints/kazbek-run-m-fidelity "$CKPT" /tmp/kazbek-run-m-fidelity.ply
export DENO_INSTALL=$HOME/.deno
command -v $DENO_INSTALL/bin/deno >/dev/null 2>&1 || (curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sh -s -- -y >/dev/null 2>&1)
STAGE=/workspace/vault-stage-m-fidelity/world/kazbek-c10
mkdir -p $STAGE
$DENO_INSTALL/bin/deno run --allow-read --allow-write /workspace/image-generation/splat-viewer/build-octree.ts /tmp/kazbek-run-m-fidelity.ply $STAGE/octree-run-m-fidelity
D=$(ls -d $STAGE/*octree* | head -1)
[ "$D" = "$STAGE/octree-run-m-fidelity" ] || mv "$D" $STAGE/octree-run-m-fidelity
python3 -c "from huggingface_hub import HfApi; HfApi().upload_large_folder(folder_path='/workspace/vault-stage-m-fidelity', repo_id='miguelemosreverte/alambique-datasets', repo_type='dataset', print_report=False)"
echo FINALIZE-m-fidelity-DONE
